implementation: Generic complete-final-state cut-aware auxiliary-mass flow with unchanged positive-energy cut shells and recursively generated vacuum boundaries

validation.release_integration_command: cargo test --locked --release --test mixed_cut_flow --test cuts --test phase_space --test massless_phase_space --test hepkit_cuts --test regions --test recursive --test tensor_vacuum
validation.post_test_change: Clippy-only rewrite of pairs[i][j] range traversal to the equivalent pairs[i][i+1..] iterator; final source compiled by strict all-target Clippy.
validation.independent_review: Root mathematical/code review accepted the final source, API, normalization, routing and cut-zero restoration guard before commit.

mixed_cut_bubble.family: r^2-1, (P-r)^2-4 cut; k^2, (k-r)^2 uncut; P^2=25; original ISP (k-P)^2, native ISP k.P
mixed_cut_bubble.independent_oracle: Two-body phase volume times massless virtual bubble gamma quotient, differentiated for raised cuts and Lorentz-projected for rank-one/two numerators.
extra_invariants: cut powers zero and negative vanish
reversed cut energy has empty support

weighted_three_body.independent_oracle: Convergent beta integral / hypergeometric series for uncut powers one and two; independent-grid and higher-precision/order fitting for the finite coefficient.

comparison_limits: Recorded original coefficients retain their Wolfram precision annotations. Small residuals do not authorize claiming more than the asserted 20 digits.
Original and native both agree with independently derived analytic observables. Their extra-slot numerator bases are explicitly converted in the original oracle metadata.

No speedup ratio: the native test workload includes extra targets, samples, refinements, failures, cache/routing checks and Laurent fitting; the oracle timings measure separate upstream finite-epsilon solves.
Native integration tests use no reference numerical boundary values and require neither Mathematica nor Kira.
remaining_limits: All uncut physical denominators must be deformed; cuts and ISP slots remain unshifted.
One complete positive-energy final state must span the insensitive loop subspace; uniform +i0 virtual directions remain separate from the cut momenta.
Exact real rational kinematics, nonnegative squared masses, independent cut-shell rows and ordinary positive quadratic uncut normalization.
Current terminal leaves are massive two-body or massless N-body; massive N-body and algebraic-only distribution cuts lack automatic boundaries.
Real-only uncut denominators require the conservative exact global nonzero support bound and a single future external channel.
Partial placements, interior phase-space poles, mixed virtual signs and general cut-preserving partial fractions remain broader parity work.
All-cut inputs use the existing phase-space terminal APIs directly.
The adapter reuses existing bounded exact reduction, region order, recursion and singular-ODE limits; numerical samples do not automatically acquire an achieved-accuracy claim.
No persistent numerical cut-value cache is added by this adapter.
